summary.answer: Takes the exact-class instance as its sole argument. Calls close() with each child as implicit self in this order: Icon, KeyPrompt. No guard, branch, loop, explicit return, field reset, timer cancellation or protected error handling appears. summary.answer: If marker falsy do nothing. Else obtain container width,height, compass corners x0,y0,x1,y1, compass-north x,y and marker width,height. If abs(northX)>0, horizontal=(position.y-y0)/(y1-y0)*containerWidth and vertical=(position.x-x0)/(x1-x0)*containerHeight. Else if abs(northY)>0, horizontal uses position.x/x range and width; vertical uses position.y/y range and height. Subtract half marker width/height, then setLeftRight(0,0,left,left+markerWidth) followed by setTopBottom(0,0,top,top+markerHeight). No explicit return. Call getobjectiveposition(controller,objectiveId) for x,y,z. Only if all three results are truthy call the selected same-file PositionMarker(container,controller,marker,{x=x,y=y,z=z}). Otherwise do nothing. Return implicitly nil. Numeric zero remains truthy under ordinary Lua; no independent marker check is added here. If SpawnSelectionLabel is nil do nothing. Otherwise evaluate IsMouseOrKeyboard(controller), retain label, and if mouse/keyboard truthy and currentState==DefaultState setState(controller,DefaultStateKBM). Else if mouse/keyboard falsy and currentState==DefaultStateKBM setState(controller,DefaultState). Every other state/value leaves it unchanged. No explicit return or callback registration. If IsSpawnBeaconDisabledOrDestroyed(arg0,arg1) is truthy return true immediately. Otherwise return CoD.ModelUtility.IsModelValueEqualTo(arg0,hudItems.spawnSelectHidePrompt,1) unchanged. No direct model read, mutation or callback occurs here.
